gameDescriptionHtml:
A 3D sci-fi action adventure game in which the player takes on the role of a small robot controlled from a third-person perspective. We wake up in a non-working system, help to activate it by activating individual systems and fight opponents who defend the necessary parts.

TL;DR – The main mechanics are fighting opponents, collecting electronic elements and launching subsequent locations using platform elements. If you like robots, light, exploration, action and nice ambient style, this might be the game for you.

Game Features

  • SYSTEM REBOOT – We wake up in a non-working system, help to activate it by activating individual systems, fight opponents who defend the necessary electronic parts and develop our combat skills.
  • COMPANION – Another small robot comes to our aid, which shows us the way and next steps.
  • SYSTEM EXPLORATION – During play we explore various parts of the system. Each location is distinguished by its unique graphic style, enemies and puzzles that we need to solve.
  • VISUALS – The production is distinguished by an ambient style based on the play of lights, shadows and reflections. We have five graphics modes at our disposal, two of which support raytracing, and the quality of raytracing can be adjusted by selecting one of the two profiles Performance and Quality.
